model.name: R19.21: In-room Members/Files tree reuses the trace browser rb-tree + rb-tree-item components.
model.description: The Members/Files tree inside a room MUST be rendered by the SAME rb-tree component used in /trace, and each tree item MUST be rendered by the SAME rb-tree-item component (Lucide icon, speaky name, word-wrap description, drag, tap-to-collapse/expand, > expander). The current inline tree in RoomView (T-room-ui v0.5.129, commit 529d5c42) does not satisfy this — re-implement using the shared components.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the in room tree should be the same as in the treacability and the items the same as the itmens there!!!"
model.refinementOfNote: Refines R19.11 (drop area + tree-overview item context), R19.12 (Members/Files tree structure), R19.13 (members as item views) with a cross-cutting component-identity constraint: the room tree and items are not new components but the SAME rb-tree and rb-tree-item already used in /trace. Discovered when Tron inspected T-room-ui v0.5.129 (commit 529d5c42) and saw an inline reimplementation instead of the shared components.
